Author: AdrianJimenezSantiago
Name: LinguaBridge
Punchline: Real-time chat translation between two languages (EN <-> FR by default).
Description: Translates incoming chat messages between two languages (English <-> French by default) using DeepL (best quality, free API key) or Google Translate (no key). Use /tr to translate and send your own messages, e.g. /tr /p Hello everyone!
